//: Fixtures that are RECORDABLE but not yet recorded, each with the date recording becomes
possible again. Conformance fails once that date passes and the fixture is still absent,
and fails again if an entry outlives the fixture it was waiting for.
This is not the same thing as a category left out of REQUIRED. `provider-error` and the
block pages are absent because they CANNOT be summoned on demand — that is a permanent
structural gap, stated in prose beside REQUIRED. An entry here is a debt with a due date.
The distinction matters because 'we could not record it this week' is exactly the kind of
note that becomes permanent by being written in prose nobody re-reads. Assertion-shaped,
it cannot rot: on the date below, CI starts saying so and does not stop.
